# Get current user — `redmine_get_current_user`

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools-doc.ts from the tool registry. Do not edit by hand; run `npm run gen:tools`. -->

_read-only_

Identify who the API key belongs to, plus optional memberships and groups — the "who am I" call to make at the start of a session for default-assignee logic and permission-aware suggestions.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `include` | `memberships` \| `groups`[] | no | Associations to expand: "memberships" (the user's projects and roles) and/or "groups". |

## Example

```json
{
  "name": "redmine_get_current_user",
  "arguments": {
    "include": [
      "memberships"
    ]
  }
}
```
